subject: planner: fix IN-subquery join+agg rewrite duplication with implicit casted RHS keys (#66897)
summary: Reviewed the join+distinct rewrite in `pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go` for `IN (subquery)`: it now materializes an implicitly-casted RHS comparison key via an inner projection and applies DISTINCT on that coerced key, then rebuilds the join predicate against the projected column to prevent incorrect row-multiplication when different inner raw values become equal after implicit cast. Integration test added covers BLOB/string-to-number cast collapsing to 0. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes to this logic (none found). No Blocker/High issues identified.
